<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

struct Edge {
    int u, flow, cost, rid;
    Edge(int u, int flow, int cost, int rid) : u(u), flow(flow), cost(cost), rid(rid) {}
};

struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    vector<vector<Edge>> al, ja;
    vector<int> d; // potentials
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    int edges;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
        N = n; S = source; T = sink; maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
        al.resize(N);
        d.assign(N, 0);
        edges = 0;
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
        edges++;
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int sz = al[i].size();
            ja[i].reserve(sz);
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; j++) {
                ja[i].push_back(al[i][j]);
            }
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    // Bellman-Ford (not used but kept for completeness)
    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    d[e.u] = min(d[e.u], d[j] + e.cost);
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // SPFA (named simple in Java)
    vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;
    bool simple() {
        node.assign(N, 0);
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, 0);
        prve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);

        node[0] = S; dist[S] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            int distu = dist[u];
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                const Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = distu + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e.u;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prve[e.u] = i; prv[e.u] = u; dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    // Dijkstra with potentials
    bool dijkstra() {
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, 0);
        prve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
        pq.emplace(0, S);
        dist[S] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            int du = p.first, u = p.second;
            if (dist[u] < du) continue;
            if (visit[u] == 2) return false;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                const Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = du + (e.cost + d[u] - d[e.u]); // reduced cost
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.emplace(cdist, e.u);
                    dist[e.u] = cdist; prv[e.u] = u; prve[e.u] = i;
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, min = INF;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            min = std::min(min, ja[pp][pe].flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= min;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += min;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += min;
        return min;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        // BellmanFord not used; just simple
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += min * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }

    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + a, (l + 1) * n + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + b, (l + 1) * n + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }

    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }

    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    // ans.calSimple(); // commented out as in Java

    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << ans.minCost << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
